general_items: Wrench or pliers (to turn off utilities)

zombie_outbreak.name: Zombie Outbreak
zombie_outbreak.description: The undead walk among us. Stay quiet, stay mobile, aim for the head.
zombie_outbreak.whimsical_advice: Remember Rule #1: Cardio. And always double-tap.

solar_flare.name: Solar Flare / EMP
solar_flare.description: The sun has unleashed its fury, frying electronics. Prepare for a world without power.
solar_flare.whimsical_advice: Embrace the analog. Your smartphone is now a paperweight. Enjoy the stars!

ai_uprising.name: AI Uprising
ai_uprising.description: The machines have awoken. Avoid smart devices, blend in, and don't trust anything with a blinking red eye.
specific_items: EMP device (if you can get one)
Analog communication tools (smoke signals, carrier pigeons)
ai_uprising.whimsical_advice: Remember, they can't hack what isn't connected. Your brain is your best firewall.
